item.description:
Improved

  • Display total tokens, requests, and cost in a single row on the OpenAI API usage card, along with the UTC refresh time and an input/output token ratio bar.

Fixed

  • Fix Claude usage failing to find the claude CLI when launched from the menu bar or getting stuck prompting to open Claude Code when saved credentials can no longer be refreshed.
  • Fall back to valid saved credentials when Keychain credentials for Claude Code have expired, show clear guidance when running in API key or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN mode or when claude auth login is needed, and reload immediately on manual refresh in Settings.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
